description: Display of Internal illuminated sequential advertisement capable of static dynamic content with automatic rotation of images.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed [Site Plan & Images (ref: 0132 0130); Technical specification Appendix A (received 01/07/2026); Cover letter (dated 29/06/2026); TfL letter (dated January 2026)]. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 
Condition : 2 - The maximum steady brightness of the advertisement hereby permitted is not to exceed 300 candelas per sq.m
Reason: To ensure the sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 3 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold
Reason: In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.
Condition : 4 - No music, smoke or sound shall be emitted from the advertisements. 
Reason: In the interest of the aural amenities of the locality in accordance with Council Policy LP2 and LP9 of the Local Plan.
Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway on Upper Tooting Road should not be blocked during the advertisement installation. Temporary obstructions during the conversion should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on Upper Tooting Road or hinder the operations of buses at the nearby bus stops. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.

INFORMATIVE: No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.

INFORMATIVE: Bus services and passengers waiting on the pavement should not be impacted during the replacement of the advertisement panel.

INFORMATIVE: All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
